name: australia-grantconnect-monitor
title: GrantConnect grants.gov.au - Grant Awards Delta Feed
description: Monitor every Australian Government grant award on GrantConnect (grants.gov.au): recipient, ABN, agency, value, purpose, program and location. Server-side filters (keyword, category, ABN, value, dates), delta mode flags new, varied and updated awards, ISO dates, numeric AUD. Pay per result.
